slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: parts
slots.about: the categories of one total: id, name, size (a number), ticked (true or false)

slots.name: clear_word
slots.about: the action before the ticked total on the button

slots.name: freed_word
slots.about: before the amount on the line shown after clearing

slots.name: note_text
slots.about: the quiet note under the button

slots.name: tick_word
slots.about: spoken before a category when not ticked

slots.name: untick_word
slots.about: spoken before a category when ticked

slots.name: empty_text
slots.about: what shows when there is no category

empty.shows: empty; the total, bar, card and note hide

fallback.shows: the button dims and does nothing; with everything at 0 the bar hides

attention.shows: after clearing, a line says how much was freed

labels.row: tick_word or untick_word, the name and the size

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops shrink and swap

notes: The donut became a segmented bar: one segment per category, filled when ticked. Rows run largest first (lower id on ties). Shares under 0.1 % read <0.1%. The Other fold and the auto-remove settings are left out.
